_doc: The writer allowlist, Lambda half (V5-SPACETENANCYKEY-001, multi-space plan V204 §2.4 'Writers', step 2.2). Read by lambda/tenancy-insert.static.test.js; the DB-function half is the allowlisted entries of tests/tenancy-prosrc-decisions.json.

unstamped: every INSERT into an S table whose workspace_id the writer rule refuses today, keyed `<statement id>><target>`, with the rule it breaks, the lane that clears it and why. It only shrinks: per (file, function) counts, ids as the listing (an id may be replaced when the old one leaves the same file:function and the count does not rise; the test prints the replacement). Must be empty for G5.

Scope-derived stamps (the value is the request's active Space) are not 2.2's (R1): they land with the resolver in each Lambda's 4.3 lane. 'mixed' = the parent is optional (a parentless row needs the scope), so the whole statement waits for 4.3.
reviewedParents: parent-row variables a reviewer accepted as a workspace_id value, per file and function (sqlCensus classifySlot reviewedParents). Also read by lambda/sql-census.static.test.js.
Re-list: node tests/lib/tenancyInsert.mjs --refused (carry lane and reason over by hand).
